notes.title: Unsouled Official Release Announcement
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=vUkZkqJJyIQ;full](정식출시 트레일러)[/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone, this is Team Unsouled!


We are finally graduating from early access and coming to you as ver1.0!
It was an extraordinary experience to actually hear your voices and experiment with many systems throughout the early access period. Thank you so much for the valuable feedback and continuous support.

Official Release Schedule
Specific release time for each timezone is listed below.
PST : 4/27 PM 04:00


Here is the new content that we’ve been preparing for the official release!

The first new piece of content is the Advanced Abyss.

Players may now summon up to five enemies they have met during gameplay and experience chaotic combat with the Advanced Abyss.

We’ve also added UI that shows the combo damage for players who like to check and experiment with their skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/69a4de60f80ff9fddd59a8f349037599afff2507.png[/img]


The ‘Mirror Dimension’ is another major piece of content included in this release.

The ‘Mirror Dimension’ is an additional challenge mode where players will find Gradiva that was touched during the gameplay.
Each Gradiva in the ‘Mirror Dimension’ will offer a challenge to the players and have them push their limits with many other missions!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/b1264b2b75cb42de8ac7cab3466f8f995e577e6a.png[/img]


We also have a special Twitter event to celebrate Unsouled’s official release, so come and check out the details :)


[b]Unsouled Official Release Twitter Event[/b]

[b][How to participate][/b]
[olist]
[*] Post a tweet with #Unsouled
[*] Include the phrase “4/27 Unsouled Official Release” in the tweet
[/olist]

[b][Event period and the prize][/b]
[olist]
[*] Event Period : 27th of April ~ 10th of May, (2 weeks)
[*] Prize : 10 lucky winners will win a Steam gift card worth $ 10 USD. It will be given through a friend invite.
[/olist]
[list]
[*] The prizes will be sent in order and there will be no further notice for those who did not win.
[/list]

Don’t miss the huge discount that will be ongoing for 2 weeks!

We hope everyone enjoys Unsouled! And once again, we’d like to sincerely thank everyone who has been supporting us and been with us throughout this journey.

We’ll be back soon with the post-release roadmap.

Thank you!
Team Unsouled

notes.title: Unsouled Official Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/e0bab16269c4842edb2dd539e40b6ac1b11caf49.png[/img]
Hello everyone, this is team Unsouled!

We finally have the official release date of Unsouled and would like to share it with you.

Unsouled will graduate Early Access on Wednesday, the 27th of April at 8am (PDT).

During the Early Access period, we’ve been both polishing and preparing it to launch on XBOX and Nintendo Switch. You will be able to experience Unsouled on all the platforms mentioned when it is officially released.

The first new piece of content for the official release is the Advanced Abyss.

Currently, the Abyss is a spacious training place where the players can freely practice combos and try out various skills. However, this felt somewhat empty and was a little lacking.

However with the Advanced Abyss, players may now summon up to five enemies that they have met during gameplay and experience chaotic combat.

We also have some QoL updates for the Abyss, such as adding UI to check the player’s combo damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/b9e4dfae013032fa913959602e98989882d9a6bf.png[/img]

Another major addition is the ‘Mirror Dimension’

The ‘Mirror Dimension’ is an additional challenge mode.

Players will find themselves in an empty space with the mirror.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/df094919e234dc4678e71f40261c57f20cb4b2ae.png[/img]

However, once the player finds and touches Gradiva (the stone statue) in the Story Mode, it will appear in this space.
The player can then experience the challenge that each Gradiva offers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/b1264b2b75cb42de8ac7cab3466f8f995e577e6a.png[/img]

The ‘Mirror Dimension’ will allow players to push their limits by having more challenging and thrilling missions.
This place can be expanded by many other upcoming contents, and will become the player’s space for collectibles.

Besides these contents, we are also designing and developing a Roguelite mode, an additional boss rush mode, and much more for after the official release.

We sincerely thank all the players who’ve been enjoying the game and sending us feedback and providing support. This all has been a great help to us.

We hope you all can have fun with the officially released Unsouled.

Please keep supporting us.

Thank you.

notes.title: Early Access Developer's Letter #5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/9d70050201fb26971ca9f8c2a1d92a2da70033e3.png[/img]Hello everyone! 

It’s been a while since our last announcement.

I want to start off by apologizing for the infrequent communications and updates despite still being in Early Access. On the other hand, thank you all for continuing to wait for Unsouled’s content.

Due to internal circumstances, in addition to PC, we are directly porting the game to Xbox and Nintendo Switch. This is taking a lot longer than expected, which is why we weren’t able to devote as much time as we’d like to working on content for the PC version.
Thankfully we are almost done, and will be able to fully focus on preparing for the content update soon!

On that note, we’d like to share a bit about where we’re heading with the content update.

Roguelite mode won’t just be a type of content that can only be used after reaching the end of the game. It can be enjoyed simultaneously with the main game, and continuously after the ending as well!

We are also planning to add bosses (which some may call the highlight of Unsouled) and new enemies inline with the game’s concepts, so be prepared to challenge yourself to more fights after the official release. 

There was also a lot of feedback received during Early Access regarding how difficult it was to understand the story. In response, we are planning to add some collection elements to improve understanding.

We are constantly reviewing the feedback received from our players, and are doing our best to implement them to improve the game.

Thank you for being patient, but we apologize as we have to ask that you wait just a bit more.

As always, thank you for continuing to support Unsouled!

Thank you,
Unsouled Team.

notes.title: Unsouled Early Access Patch Note #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/79ddd68eb2802b70eb7f021ac4234c413105a548.png[/img]
Hi everyone,

Ever since Early Access began on the 17th, we have received a lot of bug reports and improvement ideas. We’d like to say thank you, and will be reviewing each and every piece of feedback.

Among the feedback received, we have identified urgent issues that need to be prioritized for improvement and have applied fixes where possible.

Please find the details of today’s update below.

[b]1. Difficulty adjustment[/b]
A key trait of Unsouled is the sense of challenge and reward that comes from its hard difficulty. However, we have adjusted the balance of Prince of the fallen kingdom and Normal so that each difficulty is more distinct due to it being overly difficult.

[list]
[*] Increased the amount of Red Souls acquired in Prince of the fallen kingdom and Normal difficulty
[*] Added dash immunity time to Prince of the fallen kingdom and Normal difficulty
[*] Increased Attack and reduced damage when hit in Prince of the fallen kingdom and Normal difficulty
[*] Added Rookie Mode (on/off) to Prince of the fallen kingdom and Normal difficulty
[/list]

[b]2. Increased soul absorption speed when not in combat[/b]
It is possible to absorb souls during combat tactically, and it is directly related to boss difficulty. But, we have decided to adjust this due to feedback that the overall rhythm of the game is interrupted if souls are absorbed at the same speed even when out of combat.
[b]
3. Improved boss combat convenience[/b]
Boss fights are the core of Unsouled’s combat. Yet, sometimes it will be difficult to clear no matter how hard you try. Sometimes you may even need to start over to complete the Challenges! A restart feature that allows players to return to the very beginning of the Act and obtain souls for upgrade before facing the boss again was added. In addition, a quick restart feature that returns the player to the last save point is now also available.

[b]4. Modified difficulty based features in Act 2 during the part with the rolling rock[/b]
There was a good amount of feedback stating that the part where players have to avoid the rolling rock in Act 2 was overly difficult. As a result the difficulty level of Prince of the fallen kingdom and Normal was greatly reduced.

[b]5. Greatly increased the chances of acquiring Passive Soul when certain conditions are met
6. Skills can be used without additional upgrades when acquired
7. Modified the patterns of some bosses in each difficulty
8. Bug fixes[/b]

Aside from the above, other detailed improvements were also made.
We will continue to actively improve the game through user feedback during Early Access. Thank you for your feedback and interest!

Sincerely,
Unsouled Team.

notes.title: FGT Announcement & Dev Blog#4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/79ddd68eb2802b70eb7f021ac4234c413105a548.png[/img]
Hello everyone, Megusta Game here!

Today, we would like to introduce ‘Chapter 4: The Secret garden, Lam Palace’.’

But just before that, we want to give short notice about the FGT on the 6th of September.

The FGT that starts from the 6th of September will be the last beta test before the Early Access of Unsouled, which means that this is the final evaluation of our game before the launch, in which we have put a lot of hard work.

Also, it is the first time for Chapter 4, which has been partly shown in the trailers and some images, to be completely revealed. We are all quite nervous and excited at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/4ba2a3c015a28c44598dba07cbac5551ecafae13.png[/img]

We do hope that more people could experience Chapter 4. If you want to participate, please send an email to unsouled_support@neowiz.com so we can send you the key for the FGT.

Well then, let’s continue with the story on ‘The Secret garden, Lam Palace’

Some may have already noticed that we got the design motive from many places in Korea, such as Changdeokgung Palace, Dosan Seowon, Bulguksa.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/b1330c1eb70d1612935aa65fb6b2025339da25e7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/014e6947cca3f99ca2c85fb7eae4071e2ce8c994.png[/img]

Unlike the chapters before, the designs are based on the dev’s home country. We had numerous references to consider and had a high understanding of the subject, so we wanted to bring the places into the game with as much detail as possible. From the roof tile to the whole architecture, we have put in as much effort as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/6face398e355d404f349af5d6001b873edecf802.png[/img]

The look of the monsters is quite familiar to Koreans. You will recognize foot soldiers and cannon soldiers along the way. The Confucian scholars, while they are not elite monsters, will push you into an intense situation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/e55b517b7599d308986c1e1a1edf969de46c22db.png[/img]

Ammu’s necromancy gradually becomes perfect as the story advances. To show that to the players, the designs and AI of the enemies are getting closer to human-like figures. Also, we have put more effort into the fights to make actions more natural for not only the boss but also for the normal enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/91dcd2684349598107a89f318f08fe6c7f5909b6.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/55b39b2121d60881d2f5bc019bed794c263e641c.gif[/img]

Chapter 4’s boss, Gnar, is a powerful monster that uses a falchion and poison. It puts pressure on the players with constant wielding of the sword and a poison that gradually drains the HP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/173c14bca0724453d6b2a3b3871db737228c0932.gif[/img]

It is hard for us to not love it when we think about the amount of effort put into the boss stage. After the Rage Mode, the battle for phase 2 intensifies. You may not be able to properly fight against it if you haven’t fully practiced your control along the way to Chapter 4. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/fec492086a9fbcdb15583b76e49e1b8269f89f69.gif[/img]

In the Secret Garden, there are many hidden gimmicks and secret places. Open your eyes and focus during the game! You will be able to enjoy a lot more than you have expected. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/02d04a9c417a29278a74c75dc70ad95976dfd96a.png[/img]

When the player defeats ‘Gnar’, the player enters the last stage of Unsouled - Chapter 5: Ancient Monastery of Gatnis Island.

Please keep your eyes on for the next dev letter to see the last chapter of Unsouled!

Thank you for your continuous support of us, and don’t forget to participate in the FGT.

Many Thanks!

notes.title: FGT Announcement & Dev Blog#3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/79ddd68eb2802b70eb7f021ac4234c413105a548.png[/img]
Hello everyone, Megusta game here!

This time, we are going to talk about behind-the-scenes DEV episodes for ‘Chapter 3. Unbeatable Fort: Agnay Castle’

But before we dive into the episodes, we would like to talk about our plan to run Unsouled FGT on September 6th.

A lot of players gave precious feedback on Unsouled during the last CBT period, and we have worked hard to polish and improve the game based on that.

A month has passed since the CBT, and now we’d like to present our new build with improved user convenience, balance, and many others by running an FGT. 

Please do not hesitate to contact the email address below if you want to participate in the FGT, no matter whether you have participated in CBT or not. 
unsouled_support@neowiz.com


Now let’s talk about[b] ‘Chapter 3. Unbeatable Fort: Agnay Castle’[/b] and [b]‘Unchosen One, Thunder Lad’[/b].

Unbeatable Fort is where the game goes to another level in its difficulty. Players will encounter harder enemies, new gimmicks, and story branching. More to enjoy, but more to overcome.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/85c3befe6a418e364d42d3ab7e04a23dd88daff8.png[/img]


The elite monsters that come onto the stage from the Unbeatable Fort region use Ghost Orb, unlike the normal mobs. They also use more than 2~3 skills to pressure the players in various ways.


The first elite monster that players will encounter is ‘Muk Mage’. As priests who convey the word of God, they welcome necromance since they can cooperate with Ammu to use magical power when they are brought back from the dead.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/134aab9a96a4d92154835b7b02787c90ff9323ff.gif[/img]


The next elite monster is Poison Damsel. They’re experts in assassination techniques and martial arts with amazing immunity to poisons. If you turn your eyes away for a second, you’ll come back only to see a red screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/d1010af79b52b2236c2244cfc79023ff411557f8.gif[/img]


Unbeatable Fort: Agnay Castle and many enemies players encounter got their design ideas from India, especially from the Chittorgarh and Amber fort. We have put a lot of work to restore extremely comprehensive structures, geometric patterns, and carvings into the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/cd579fbf44bce513b089096967ee666aa0a6e35d.png[/img]


We are quite proud of the magnificent front view of Agnay Castle that can be seen from the boat
.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/ffcff69d6137d01ce93070f04f0ab8328fe2807b.png[/img]


The temple with lots of patterns and carvings is also a result of thorough consideration and effort. For pixel work, we feel like we did our best. Hope many players also feel the same when they see it. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/f3382834b2d51b7368121e524c8e4d47b71db07b.png[/img]


The Boss of Chapter 3, Lad uses a lightning-fast pattern using both bow and sword, and actual lightning to attack the player. It matches his nickname, ‘Unchosen One, Thunder’ - It always brings lightning storms with it, pressuring a player to choose fast between guard and counterattack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/33c8b30a75fa50ee2fb33fdb160ccfd70a73ca56.gif[/img]


Lad is one of the most aggressive bosses of all. It enters the rage mode during its attack, not when his HP drops to a certain point, pressuring a player even more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/77f1eb04dcf1e1803bcb86fb1e097ea440fb7c12.png[/img]


The player who defeats ‘Unchosen One, Thunder Lad’ departs ‘Unbeatable Fort: Agnay Castle’ and enters a mysterious region that has never been covered before,[b] ‘Chapter 4. The Secret Garden: Lam Palace’[/b].

We will shed some more light on Lam palace in the next DEV episodes! Do not forget to apply for the FGT, too!


Thanks!

notes.title: Dev Blog#2-Valley of Namam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/79ddd68eb2802b70eb7f021ac4234c413105a548.png[/img]
Hello everyone, Megusta Game here!


Just as we mentioned last week, this time we will talk about behind-the-scenes DEV episodes for [b]‘Chapter 2. Valley of Namam’ [/b]and the Boss[b] ‘Seven Flames, Irus.’ 
[/b]

After defeating the first Boss Niug, the players probably stepped into the scenery of ‘Chapter 2. Valley of Namam’ with confidence. However, the feeling quickly fades away, encountering enemies with brand new patterns and environmental barriers such as sand storms.


We got the design idea for the Valley of Namam from the Siq Canyon of Jordan, widely known as the Petra monument.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/b73baf03dc18228111076023fcb54f843e3bcf5f.png[/img]


With such complicated geographical features, the Valley of Namam acts as a natural fortress for Odibil the desert kingdom. It is also a home base of the Iznuch cult and where the Nalub assassin crew is perched.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/778f31529294b7c50b58b4754b55d4efa92a19d3.png[/img]


As some players may have noticed, running away from a huge ball of rock is a homage to a scene in Indiana Jones. Seeing many players surprised by the sudden chasing scene, we were glad that we reached our goal. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/d60cb460b340e2845cf967cbbc7e313ae1b90116.gif[/img]


Desert and moor are not the only sceneries that can be seen at the Valley of Namam. Deep in the desert, there are fortress-like sanctums of Iznuch. We made the places closely resemble architectural styles of Persian buildings, especially Herod’s Palace. It was a difficult task to realize a place from another culture that one has never experienced before, but we are satisfied with the overall result.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/1c24b8f9be4a8f1375f18b5c79e8639915e29d0b.png[/img]


After all these difficulties, the players finally meet the Boss of Chapter 2, ‘Seven Flames, Irus’ from the place that resembles the Petra ruins. As the name tells, Irus suffocates players from all directions with its fascinating flames. Unlike the first Boss Niug, it holds a player back with its long-distance attacks and overpowers approaching opponents with its invincible skills. It has some complexity, which will make players think of a fighting game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/3abcee648dc20362e04a0138581cda4dc4b8f4f6.gif[/img]


Those who have read the DEV episodes may have already noticed that Unsouled gets its ideas from unique cultural places all over the world. Enjoy Unsouled as if you are traveling the world, with stages filled with unique concepts and stunning pixel art!


And that just about does it for Chapter 2: Valley of Namam. Next time we’ll be back with DEV episodes on [b]‘Chapter 3. Unbeatable Fort: Agnai Castle.’[/b]


Bye until next time!

notes.title: End of CBT Announcement & Dev Blog#1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/79ddd68eb2802b70eb7f021ac4234c413105a548.png[/img]
Hello everyone, Megusta Game here!

Thanks to everyone’s support, the first CBT-Creator Beta Test has successfully come to an end.

All the valuable feedback you have provided will be thoroughly considered, and we will be trying our best to reflect that in future updates until the official launch. 

Continuing on, we’re planning to run a FGT with some balance updates AND brand new Chapter 4. If you are interested, feel free to contact us via our official discord channel, or email unsouled_support@neowiz.com 

With that being said, now we’d like to talk about some behind-the-scenes DEV episodes for each chapter. 


Our first round comes with[b] ‘Chapter 1. Illi Plateau’[/b], which may have been thought to be a tutorial part like other game’s first stages, but turned out to be quite brutal for many players.

We got the design idea for ‘Chapter 1. Illi Plateau, Ancient Heritage’ from Hierapolis (Turkey) and the architecture styles of Greeks and Roman temples.

Mobs’ art design matches their background stories as undead summoned by necromancy, with their monstrous green skin and yellow eyes. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/de5423d44fc0177171f1ffdcb4dc80accc27f57c.png[/img]


If you have taken a close look at the buildings in the game, you may have already recognized that it resembles Roman architectural style. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/00a5b9f6d1577c48450f7d7e5d61055d27b27fd1.png[/img]


The overall design of the ruins portray a once magnificent yet faded kingdom, its decadence also illustrated by the boss Niug.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/1bf3490ff4a92e04ee01f1a7c64ffebf0d98e80b.png[/img]


We also brought Turkey’s Hierapolis into Niug’s boss room. While it had been a tremendous amount of work to restore it into the game, it’s also something we’re quite proud of.

Our first boss, Niug, came out as a result of detailed consideration and effort. We all agreed that it is not an Unsouled-style to overwhelm players with a gigantic boss, but we also couldn’t give up on adding some intensity to our very first boss.

With the size not being an option, we tried to bring some intensity with other methods. The lightning-fast dash and chained pattern that comes right after it are examples of our effort to surprise the players who meet Niug for the first time, and we believe we have managed to reach our goal! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/cf7e8e81c05afdd07e168dc1d30dbe6bb41716c7.gif[/img]


That’s about it for now on Chapter 1. Illi Plateau: Ancient Heritage. We’ll come back to shed some more light on [b]Chapter 2: Valley of Namam[/b]! Stay tuned for more amazing information on our Unsouled world :)


Thanks again for your support!

notes.title: Unsouled’s Development Status and Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/79ddd68eb2802b70eb7f021ac4234c413105a548.png[/img]
Hello! Megusta Game here!

It’s been a while since our last post, but we’re back with some important news for you. Please see below for a detailed breakdown of the current development status of Unsouled and our plans for it in the future.


[b][Development Status][/b]
The main story of the game is all developed and prepared for the Early Access launch, and we are now working on 3 main features (listed below).
[b]
1. Currently Working on Boss Rush Mode[/b]
Defeating various Bosses with unique mechanisms is one of the best parts of the game. As a way to maximize the fun of boss fights, the Boss rush mode is under development and will be included in the Early Access version of the game. It will provide players with Unsouled’s signature stylish and fast-paced action.


[b]2. Perfect Balancing & Flesh Out Story[/b]
Game balance is one of the things that Unsouled cares about the most to enhance our game experience. We are adjusting the balance between enemies and the playable character in combat, so that first-time players can start with a moderately challenging level of difficulty. The game balance will be continuously revised throughout the EA period and a final check will be done through various tests in future.
Likewise, the story of the game is being revised in a big way so that players will be fully immersed in the game itself.



[b]3. Improve the UI/UX[/b]
When you play the game several times, the most eye-catching place is the interface related to the HP, stamina, and various souls. We are improving UI/UX in an intuitive way to make it easier to understand everything, and we welcome feedback about this during Early Access.




[b][Our Future Plans][/b]

Considering our current status, we plan to follow the roadmap outlined below. The Early Access launch has been delayed a little bit, but that will allow us to deliver a more polished game at launch and make some major changes to the overall plan.


[b]- July[/b]
-----------------------------------
1. Run a beta test for our backers and content creators.
   - Up to Chapter 3 will be playable and we plan to give access to all of our backers according to this schedule.
2. Reveal the Early Access Launch Trailer and new cover art.
3. Participate in the PLAYX4 Online Game Convention.
4. Take part in PAX Online to share Unsouled with the gaming community.
-----------------------------------

[b] - August [/b]
-----------------------------------
1. Finish QA and localization
-----------------------------------

 [b]- September[/b]
-----------------------------------
1. Launch the Early Access version on Steam and the Epic Game Store
Unsouled will be released on both the Epic Games Store as well as Steam, which will help grow our community and the Boss Rush mode will be included in the Early Access too.

2. Participate in Bitsummit (Japanese Game Convention) and the China Game Festival (Chinese Indie Game Convention).
-----------------------------------

[b] - December[/b]
-----------------------------------
1.  Update the ‘Roguelite Mode’.
-----------------------------------

[b] - 1Q 2022[/b]
-----------------------------------
1. Launch the 1.0 version of Unsouled on PC.
2. We’ll also do our best to release the Switch, Xbox and PS4 versions of Unsouled at or around this time.
-----------------------------------

That’s our plan as it stands now and we hope you like it. We’ll try our hardest to make the wait worth it for you and aim to make the best possible version of Unsouled that we can.

So please stay tuned!

Thank you!
